code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia (notably neutropenia and lymphopenia), mild thrombocytopenia, and increased red cell distribution width, suggesting possible bone marrow dysfunction or systemic illness. Mild hypoproteinemia and hypocalcemia are present. Electrolytes and liver/renal function are within normal limits. Clinical correlation is recommended to investigate underlying causes such as infection, inflammation, or hematologic disorder. Urgent evaluation is advised due to severe hypoxemia and cytopenias.
